author: praasz
title: NPU Models Tests fail with KeyError on aten.upsample_vec ops not in decomp table
signature: keyerror opoverload op aten upsample vec not found in decomp table|Flaky Test
key_errors: WARNING:root:Operation aten.upsample_bilinear2d.vec not found in decomp table
File: openvino/frontend/pytorch/fx_decoder.py, line 290, in from_exported_program: cls._decomp_table.pop(op)
root_cause: The NPU Models Tests attempted to pop 'aten.upsample_nearest2d.vec' and 'aten.upsample_bilinear2d.vec' from the PyTorch FX decoder decomp table, but these ops were not present in the table for this PyTorch version on Windows. The tests themselves passed (4 passed, 7 skipped per group). The overall_status job failed because the first attempt of NPU tests failed, triggering ci/gha_overall_status_windows to exit 1. The PR changes (IR FE XmlDeserializer for Constant layer attributes) are unrelated to NPU/PyTorch frontend code.
reproduction_steps: Run NPU model hub tests on Windows with PyTorch installed: pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_easyocr.py -k NPU on a Windows runner with NPU hardware (4000, 5010, or 5020).
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs to verify they pass on retry (tests passed 4/4 in both logged attempts, suggesting the overall_status failure is from attempt 1 state)
Check if aten.upsample_nearest2d.vec and aten.upsample_bilinear2d.vec need to be added to the decomp exclusion list in fx_decoder.py
Investigate if this is a PyTorch version compatibility issue with the decomp table on Windows
prevention_strategies: Guard the _decomp_table.pop() calls in fx_decoder.py with existence checks to avoid KeyError when ops are not in the decomp table.
historical_context: No prior occurrences of this specific pattern found in the investigation history.
